title: Synthetic repeatable rotating-component vibration screen
provenance_detail: Original synthetic screening guidance authored for the demonstration from public observable signal concepts; it contains no external source text.

chunks.evidence_excerpt: For repeatable rotating-component vibration in this synthetic demonstration, compare the vibration trend across unloaded, cutting, and coast-down observations, then review lubrication indication and sensor attachment. Persistence across conditions is evidence for further inspection, not identification of a failed component.
chunks.possible_explanation: A rotating-element wear, lubrication, attachment, or sensing condition is possible.
suggested_checks: Compare vibration trends across unloaded, cutting, and coast-down observations.
Verify the vibration sensor attachment and repeat the reading.
Review the available lubrication indication and synthetic maintenance history.
limitations: No frequency spectrum, calibrated baseline, physical inspection result, or industrial threshold is present.
The note supports screening only and cannot identify a component failure.
